brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, 1536×864 or larger. It must be a polished non-photorealistic hand-drawn ink-and-dry-brush sports illustration with very bold clean Japanese typography. Approved house style: almost-black #151A18 background, vivid lime #CCF43B brush swaths and sparse splatter, warm ivory type, dramatic black-and-ivory crosshatching on the real athlete. Ball is the only orange accent, uniform predominantly ivory/black. Few elements, no photographic textures.

Subject: real basketball player SHOGO TAMAKI (玉木祥護) of Ehime Orange Vikings. Do not draw a generic invented athlete. I have inspected his current official roster portrait at https://bleague.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=2026111315/files/user/roster/723/2026-27/20003_01.jpg and observed: Japanese male around 30, tall 195cm powerful athletic build and broad shoulders; long straight black hair swept back, extending to the nape/shoulders, wide plain black headband across forehead, slightly long oval/angular face, straight rather thick eyebrows, almond-shaped dark eyes, defined straight nose, narrow black moustache and short goatee/chin beard connected around the chin, defined jawline. Preserve those specific likeness features in a clearly illustrated face, not a photograph, caricature, or anonymous substitute.
Pose: a powerful low forward step and torso pivot with a basketball held in BOTH hands at lower chest/waist, head turned in three-quarter view toward viewer/right, focused expression, face fully clear. Player fills LEFT 43% of composition, from head to upper thighs; energetic foreshortening but anatomically natural arms, two hands, natural fingers gripping the ball, no extra limbs. Ball and head fully within canvas, at least 5% safe margin. Plain sleeveless basketball kit WITHOUT number, text, team badge, sponsor, manufacturer, or league logo. Do not paste or reproduce any official photo. Only ONE athlete.

Composition: large legible headline occupies the RIGHT 55%, clean separated area, with a rough lime diagonal brush behind the left athlete. Different composition from a right-side jump-shooter. Premium editorial poster, excellent text contrast, all text stays inside 5% safe margin. Footer is a clean dark strip. Do not cover any writing with the player or splatter.

Exact text only (do not add any other words, names, scores or numbers):
small masthead upper right: 「バスケまとめ」
large lime date: 「11/14」
very large ivory main headline: 「試合結果」
smaller supporting line: 「当日EFF・ポジション別TOP3」
qualifier immediately below, visibly readable: 「公式ポジション確認後に掲載」
bottom footer: 「イラスト（AI生成）　イメージ」

Editorial accuracy: The only source for article content is a frozen local manuscript headed '11/14 試合結果・当日のEFF'. It lists results, but B.PREMIER and B.ONE positional EFF TOP3 are not yet published because official player positions remain unconfirmed. This thumbnail must not imply any EFF rankings have been established. The athlete is RANDOMLY selected from a team mentioned in that manuscript solely for the illustration. Never print his name, stats, award, playing-time, win, or performance claims. The pictured action is an illustrative basketball pose, NOT a recreation of an actual 11/14 game, decisive play or highlight. The footer must explicitly include both イラスト（AI生成） and イメージ. No league/team logos, no official photo, no fabricated scoreboards, no photorealism, no extra players. Render exact Japanese text accurately, horizontal upright heavy gothic lettering.
